product_context.name: Game Stream Highlight Tool
product_context.description: A modular web application for detecting, editing, and exporting highlight moments from gaming streams.

needs: Automated detection of high-engagement moments in streams.
Filtering and sorting highlights by game, category, or score.
Manual adjustment tools for fine-tuning highlights.
Efficient tools to extract and organize highlight moments.
Exportable lists or clips for further editing.
Aggregated data on high-performing moments across multiple streamers.

screens.name: Dashboard
features: Stream list with filtering and sorting options.

screens.name: Highlight Editor
features: Manual adjustment tools for fine-tuning highlights.

screens.name: Export Screen
features: Options to export highlight lists or clips.

design_principles: Clarity: Ensure the interface is intuitive and easy to navigate.
Efficiency: Minimize the number of steps required to achieve key tasks.
Customization: Allow users to tailor the tool to their specific needs.

ui_structure_contract.design_goal: A clear product workbench for stream/video operators, not a raw form dump. Prioritize scanability, obvious ownership of each control, and progressive complexity.

frontend.reason: Highly modular and suitable for building dynamic, interactive GUIs.

backend.reason: Lightweight and efficient for handling API requests and data processing.

AI/ML.reason: Robust library for training and deploying models for highlight detection.

export_format: MP4 or other video formats for clips.

test_strategy.responsibility: Test individual components and modules for functionality.
Ensure seamless interaction between frontend, backend, and AI/ML modules.
Gather feedback from streamers and editors on usability.
Test application performance with large datasets.

acceptance_criteria: Generated project must run locally from index.html under python -m http.server.
Provide a real JSON import path using FileReader and/or a textarea; imported data must be processed by the app.
Implement a real scoring function and sort detected items by score descending in executable JavaScript.
Provide visible filter controls and executable filter logic for the requested fields.
Provide a manual marker form/control that appends a new item to the working dataset and rerenders results.
Provide a real export action using Blob, URL.createObjectURL, an anchor download, and the current filtered result set.
Persist working data locally with localStorage and reload it on page load.
Use domain fields such as streamer, game, timestamp/time, category, intensity, chatRate, keywords, title, description, and score.
